meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织好画面轨道与子合成,让项目如期渲染
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做动画合成,想一次写对项目结构避免返工
copy.tagline_en: Organize tracks and sub-compositions to make your project render reliably
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're creating animated compositions and want to get the structure right without rework

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按一套固定规则来制作「用网页代码生成视频」的项目:把每个画面出现的时间点写进网页标记里,只建一条可拖动的时间轴,保证每次渲染的画面一致,并能通过代码检查。
howto.when: 当你要编写或修改 HyperFrames 项目的网页代码、做 STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md 等计划文件,或校验渲染结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭一个最小的 HyperFrames 视频项目:定好画面尺寸和总时长。
say.note: Claude 会按这套规则生成一个能直接渲染的最小项目。

say.text: 给两个片段加上 data-start 和 data-duration,按顺序放。
say.note: 时间轴会按你写的秒数依次排列。

say.text: 跑一遍 npx hyperframes check,把所有校验问题修掉。
say.note: 校验错误清零后,布局与对比度审计才会真正生效。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude follows fixed rules to build projects that turn web code into video: shot timings live in page markup, one draggable timeline exists, renders stay identical, and code checks pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write or edit a HyperFrames project's web code, draft plan files such as STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md, or validate a render's output.

say_en.text: Build me a minimal HyperFrames project: set the root's size and duration.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a renderable skeleton per the rules.

say_en.text: Add data-start and data-duration to two clips, placed in order.
say_en.note: The timeline will be ordered by the seconds you specify.

say_en.text: Run npx hyperframes check and fix all validation errors.
say_en.note: Layout and contrast audits only run after lint errors clear.
